reviewScope: Manual classification of complete lexical candidate sets in four shared core sources: flow-layout diagnostics, public module projection, administration V5 validation, and legacy Puxadores repair. Only administration feedback surfaced to users is localizable; internal diagnostics are excluded and axis/measurement formatting is deferred for domain review.
limitations: Inventory only: product code and locale bundles remain unchanged.

Classification follows current call sites: flow-layout errors are logged/stored internally; public module projection errors are sanitized by the endpoint; selected administration validation and repair failures are shown in admin feedback.
Axis order and formatted dimensions require a locale-aware domain decision before resource design.
